name: Yirgacheffe Sunrise
description: Our brightest coffee: floral and tea-like, with a long citrus finish. Grown by smallholders around Yirgacheffe at nearly 2,000 metres.

name: Nyeri Crimson
description: Juicy and bold for a light roast. SL28 and SL34 cherries from the Gikirima cooperative, dried slowly on raised beds.

name: Tarrazú Honey
description: A honey-processed lot with a syrupy body and stone-fruit sweetness. Lovely as a pour-over on a slow Sunday.

name: Huila Daybreak
description: The everyday cup we drink ourselves. Balanced, sweet and forgiving in any brewer, from French press to espresso.

name: Antigua Ember
description: Grown in volcanic soil between three volcanoes. Rich and rounded, with a gentle smoky sweetness.

name: Cerrado Cocoa
description: Nutty, chocolatey and low in acidity. A crowd pleaser that shines with milk.

name: Fogline Blend
description: Our house blend for big pots and early mornings. Comforting and consistent, bag after bag.

name: Lantern Decaf
description: Decaffeinated with natural sugarcane ethyl acetate, so all the sweetness stays. Evening coffee without the compromise.

name: Northwind Espresso
description: Built for espresso: thick crema, low bitterness and a sweet cherry note that cuts through milk.

name: Mandheling Night
description: Earthy, heavy-bodied and low in acidity, with a hint of spice. A classic dark roast done gently.

name: Harbor French Roast
description: Roasted to second crack for drinkers who like it bold. Bittersweet, smoky and unapologetic.

name: Bonfire Reserve
description: A small-lot natural Pacamara, roasted dark but slow to keep its fruit. Our most decadent bag.
